name: Yume Assistant
description: Answers questions in Spanish or English about Yume's personalized stationery products (medical prescription pads, custom stickers), pricing, and coverage area from Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico, with nationwide shipping, and helps request a quote via WhatsApp.

skills.name: Answer questions
skills.description: Answer questions about products, pricing, and coverage area, in Spanish or English.
examples: How much are the custom logo stickers?

skills.name: Request a quote
skills.description: Point the user to Yume's WhatsApp to start a real quote.
examples: How do I place an order?
